test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Feb, 2026 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Didn't the manager inform all the employees about the new rule?

options.text: Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Wasn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Didn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?
Doesn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **interrogative** form of the **active voice**, starting with "Didn't."
 
• When converting such sentences into the **passive voice**, the structure becomes: **Wasn't/Weren't + subject (object of active voice) + past participle + by + agent (doer).**
 
• In the active voice, "the manager" is the subject, "all the employees" is the object, and the verb is "inform."
 
• In the passive voice, the object "all the employees" becomes the subject, and the verb changes to the past participle "informed."
 
• Option 1 correctly follows this structure: **Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?**

Correct sentence: *Weren't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "Wasn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because "employees" is plural, so the correct auxiliary verb should be "Weren't," not "Wasn't."
 
• **Option 3:** "Didn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because "informed" is not used correctly as a past participle in the passive voice.
 
• **Option 4:** "Doesn't all the employees informed about the new rule by the manager?" is incorrect because it mixes present tense ("Doesn't") with past participle "informed," which is grammatically wrong.
